svg.title: The square, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Module 3 final project on a 3 by 3 taped grid. The robot starts parked on the bottom-left intersection, the corner nearest you, facing away from you. It drives up the left side: its sensors reach the first intersection, it drives on to park its wheels there, then does the same at the second, the top-left corner. It turns right and drives along the top two intersections, turns right and drives down the right side, turns right and drives along the bottom back to the start, and turns right once more, ending facing the way it began. A panel beside it names each stage: side 1 to 4, arriving at intersection 1 or 2, turning right, and square complete.
svg.text: Each side is two arrivals: the sensors
robot drives on to park its wheels on
it. Four right turns make 360 degrees,
so it ends facing the way it started.

g.text: parked on the start corner, facing away
back at start, facing the way it began
